title: Stale NetBox — RT Mismatch on Recently Provisioned dc1-leaf1b
symptom: MAC not seen on remote VTEPs from dc1-leaf1b. EVPN sessions Established. NetBox data for dc1-leaf1b may be stale after recent recabling.
root_cause: Route-target export for VLAN 12 changed to 10012:55555 on dc1-leaf1b. NetBox still shows old VNI/VLAN mapping. Intent data is incomplete/stale.
fix_command:
router bgp 65101
vlan 12
no route-target both 10012:55555
route-target both 10012:10012
